info.title: Hosts Config API
info.description: Keep hosts, folders and sharing in a YAML or JSON file. Termix loads them as read only hosts and reloads when the file changes.

bearerAuth.description: Session token sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the token.

cookieAuth.name: jwt
cookieAuth.description: Session JWT cookie set at sign-in. When present, it takes precedence over the Authorization header.

apiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the key, which starts with tmx_. It acts as the key owner and cannot act as anyone else.

get.description: The file path, when it last applied, how many hosts it manages, and any problems from the last load.

post.description: Reads the file again and applies it, even when it has not changed. A file with problems applies nothing.

200.description: The status after the load. errors is empty when it applied.
